decisions.summary: The grove is the precinct: a near-rectangle filling the sheet's frame, widened from about 117 to about 137 ft so each side of the clearing carries two or three crowns (settlement-review read a single file of trees as a hedge), from the shrine well at its back edge to the outermost arch (about 223 ft), about 860 tsubo; the band T-program writes is R2's register figures as found, never widened to fit
decisions.why: FR-007 fixes the grove's reach and requires its area inside the register band FR-005 records; programs.md line 84 records that band as the registers as found (Saitama 55-708, Tochigi 142-2,700, Saga 50-662, with medians), not widened. Measured this round on the map manifest (village_groves role shrine, 2 ft/px): w 68.3 px, h 111.7 px = 136.6 by 223.4 ft = about 858 tsubo; on the sheet the precinct rect is 410 by 670 px at 3 px/ft = 136.7 by 223.3 ft. 858 is inside Tochigi's 142-2,700 register, so FR-007 holds. The widening serves the request rather than departing from it: the spec forbids a precinct hedge (FR-004, the GM's question what purpose a wall serves) and a one-tree file on each side read as exactly that, so a wood deep enough to read as wood is the grove the GM ruled for ('a grove around the shrine'), not a carve-out. research.md's arithmetic phrase ('above Saitama's top and Tochigi's mean of 817, far inside Tochigi's range') is correct. Condition (stale figure already in the record): research/religion-and-death/124-how-large-was-a-village-shrines-precinct-and-how-much-of-it-was-built-on.html line 9 still says 'about 730 tsubo ... above Tochigi's median of 655' (and carries a doubled comma, 'as found,,'), and its notes fragment note 4's comment says 730; bring both to about 858 and 'above Tochigi's mean of 817', and the sheet's svg comment line 51 from '117 by 223 ft' to 137, before the push. Not a narrowing; the ruling does not rest on them

decisions.summary: A 37 ft forecourt before the hall holding the three innermost arches; the swept clearing grows from 272 by 244 to 272 by 334 px (about 91 by 111 ft), 28% to 33% of the precinct, hall included
decisions.why: FR-008 and the GM's ruling ask for 'a small swept clearing at the hall' and SC-002 for built and swept ground a small share, the rest grove; 'small' is a degree the request leaves unquantified (calibrated liberty), the grove still holds two thirds of the precinct, the innermost arch still stands one pitch off the hall (FR-008, US2 scenario 4), and no enclosure returns. It does not narrow anything asked. It is, however, a design decision that moves SC-002's share and is recorded only in the sheet's notes (as a guess from use); condition: record it in research.md's Design decisions beside D6 with its class and the share, so a later reader of the plan sees it. Aside for the GM: at about 280 tsubo the clearing alone exceeds Saga's median whole precinct; whether a third of the precinct is 'small' is theirs to say once they see the sheet
